clock_animations.note: Clock animation requires a separate hook site from the charge-screen timeout effects. The clock is drawn when the timeout bit is CLEAR (beq 0x9a32 in FUN_00009a10). See resources/re/af_190602-dispatcher-analy.md §7 for the clock pathway. Hook site addresses below are placeholders from RE notes — confirm against af_190602.dec.bin before flash.
